name: Cedergrenska AB (publ)
summary: Cedergrenska AB (publ) specializes in delivering educational services, spanning from early childhood (preschool) to post-secondary levels. Its operations encompass a variety of institutions such as primary schools, preschools, marine polytechnic schools, and gymnasiums, alongside offering teacher training programs. Founded in 2017, this Stocksund, Sweden-based company currently oversees 24 schools and preschools situated throughout Sweden.
